query: SELECT v.id,v.uuid,v.instance_name,v.state,h.private_ip_address,d.template_version,d.scripts_version,d.software_version,t.name FROM vm_instance v JOIN domain_router d ON d.id=v.id LEFT JOIN host h ON h.id=v.host_id JOIN vm_template t ON t.id=v.vm_template_id WHERE (t.uuid='1846bd8c-a780-4918-a12d-23db003a78a8' OR v.uuid='e054e33f-8941-4d8e-b569-cb530c622254') AND v.removed IS NULL;
